LESSON: WRITING 10.4.1 CREATIVE WRITING: DESCRIPTIVE COMPOSITIONS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.4: Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Compositions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Compositions, part of Strand 10 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four General.

Key inquiry question: Why should you organise your thoughts in clear sentences and paragraphs? 2. How can you tell others about yourself?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Compositions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Citizenship: active community life skills as learners talk, as they sign, about different activities they engage in such as ‘how we clean our house’.

Values:
Unity: cooperation as learners work together in groups to write a descriptive composition.

Link to other subjects:

Learner is able to link the concept of descriptive writing to their learning in Kiswahili.
